title: Irish Northern Irish Cheese Tagine
description: A twist on the traditional tagine, this Irish northern dish combines baked cheese with the flavors of the tagine.
instructions: Bake the sweet potatoes for 45 minutes, or until tender.
In a separate pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the tagine seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the baked sweet potatoes to the cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped parsley.
Bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
